key_insight: Encoding the ICD-10-CM hierarchy as an explicit model input improves EHR representation learning compared with treating diagnosis codes as flat tokens.
clinical_relevance: Hierarchy-aware code representations may better capture clinically meaningful relationships between diagnoses, which can strengthen prediction and transfer across hospitals or datasets.
method: BERT-style transformer with extra tokens for different ICD hierarchy levels
Graph-based code embeddings using hierarchy-aware edges plus diagnosis co-occurrence
Compared flat vs hierarchy-aware representations across in-domain and cross-dataset settings
evidence_signal: Evaluated on MIMIC-IV for pretraining/in-domain testing and eICU for frozen-encoder transfer, showing hierarchy helped in both settings.
watch_item: Benefits varied by task, model type, and hierarchy level, so implementation needs careful selection of which hierarchy depth to encode.
paper_title: Hierarchical Modeling of ICD Codes in EHR Foundation Models
